v.s: And when the stars fall, scattering,
v.c: and when the stars fall away,

q: (when fresh and salt water bodies will merge to become one mass of water, after which all will be evaporated as mentioned in verse 6 of the previous Surah)...
v.s: And when the seas are erupted
v.c: and when the seas burst forth,

q: (and empty their contents so that people appear before Allaah for reckoning)
v.s: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered [i.e., exposed],
v.c: and when the graves spill out,

q: ...(when all these things happen on the Day of Qiyaamah,)
every soul shall come to know what it had sent ahead
(what actions were done in the world to be rewarded or punished])
(what actions were left undone in the world to be rewarded or punished).
v.s: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.
v.c: ˹then˺ each soul will know what it has sent forth or left behind.

q: O man! What has cast you into deception concerning your Most Generous Rabb?

(Why do you continue sinning believing that Allaah will always forgive you because He is Generous? This attitude shows disloyalty to Allaah Who has blessed man with innumerable bounties. Among these are that Allaah is the One)...
v.s: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,
v.c: O humanity! What has emboldened you against your Lord, the Most Generous,

v.s: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?
v.c: Who created you, fashioned you, and perfected your design,

q: ...and made you in the fashion He desired
v.s: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.
v.c: moulding you in whatever form He willed?

q: (you should never be deceived like this! Far from being merely deceived by Allaah's generosity,)
(the Kuffaar continuously sin because they actually)
v.s: No! But you deny the Recompense.
v.c: But no! In fact, you deny the ˹final˺ Judgment,

v.s: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,
v.c: while you are certainly observed by vigilant,

q: (and record it so that you cannot deny it on the Day of Qiyaamah).

v.s: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,
v.c: Indeed, the virtuous will be in bliss,

v.s: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.
v.c: and the wicked will be in Hell,

q: ...which they will enter on the Day of Retribution
v.s: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,
v.c: burning in it on Judgment Day,

v.s: And never therefrom will they be absent.
v.c: and they will have no escape from it.

q: Do you know what the Day of Retribution is?
v.s: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
v.c: What will make you realize what Judgment Day is?

q: Do you really know what the Day of Retribution is?
v.s: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
v.c: Again, what will make you realize what Judgment Day is?

q: It shall be a day when one soul will be unable to benefit
another soul in the least. On that day all authority will be Allaah's
(and no one else will have any say in the judgment of affairs).
v.s: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with God.
v.c: ˹It is˺ the Day no soul will be of ˹any˺ benefit to another whatsoever, for all authority on that Day belongs to Allah ˹entirely˺.
